items.title: RIKEN reports holding 'Mathematics & AI Symposium 2026'
items.summary_en: RIKEN's official news section reportedly published an item (URL date-code 20260904) describing a 'RIKEN Mathematics & AI Symposium 2026' that brought together international researchers to discuss AI-driven mathematical discovery and the use of mathematical theory to improve AI reliability, with roughly 300 in-person and online attendees. The exact symposium dates could not be confirmed: search-engine summaries of the page conflicted (one suggested mid-to-late August, another implied an early-September event), and the underlying page could not be directly fetched to resolve this because riken.jp domains are blocked in this collection environment.
items.notes: Reconstructed via WebSearch only; the primary page at riken.jp could not be directly accessed or verified due to an environment-wide egress block on riken.jp/aip.riken.jp domains (confirmed on this run and the two prior runs, 2026-08-13 and 2026-08-29). Event date details are uncertain/conflicting across search summaries -- treat specifics with caution pending direct verification. This is a RIKEN-wide mathematics/AI event, not confirmed as organized specifically by the AIP center. Original language: Japanese-origin institution reported via its own English-language news page.

coverage_note: Direct access to aip.riken.jp, www.riken.jp, pri.riken.jp, and www.u-tokyo.ac.jp was blocked by the environment's egress proxy on this run, confirming the access restriction persists for a THIRD consecutive run (2026-08-13, 2026-08-29, 2026-09-12). This appears to be an environment-wide egress restriction rather than an absence of news at the target and should be raised with whoever operates the harness rather than treated as evaluator/academia rotation noise. WebSearch-based reconstruction was attempted as a fallback per instructions. Most reconstructed candidate items (AIP conference paper-acceptance posts for ICML/ACL/ICLR/AISTATS/CVPR/EACL 2026, an NTT Facilities Journal interview with Naonori Ueda, a RIKEN iTHEMS fellowship for Leo Speidel) either predate the 2026-08-29 to 2026-09-12 collection window or fall outside AIP's scope (genomics research at a different RIKEN center), so they were excluded. Only one plausibly in-window item (a Mathematics & AI Symposium 2026 news post) could be reconstructed, and it is flagged as secondary-source/low-confidence because it could not be cross-checked against the primary page. No University of Tokyo AI-specific research news within the window could be reliably reconstructed via search either; the only U-Tokyo AI-related items found (GCI World 2026 course, Institute for AI and Beyond) either concern a future event (starting 2026-09-17, outside the window) or lack a clear in-window publication date.
